Title: Shalmath's "search your library for an action card"

Messages.Author: Raynor
Messages.Body:
Hi all!

Sorry for posing such a stupid question, but I can't seem to find the
answer.

Can Shalmath use his ability to search the library for an equipment,
ally, retainer or politcal action card? They are considered "action
cards" as per the "all rulings" page of the WW homepage:
"Actions:
# Between the time the action card (including ally, equipment,
retainer, and political action cards) is played and ... "

Shalmath [HttB:U]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: True Brujah
Group: 6
Capacity: 10
Discipline: POT PRE TEM
Independent: Shalmath may search your library for an action card to
move to your research area as a +1 stealth action. Once each turn, he
may untap. He cannot play cards that require Celerity [cel]. Scarce.
Artist: Larry Snelly
